title: 2016 AMC 10A Problem 7
statement: The mean, median, and mode of the \(7\) data values \[60, 100, x, 40, 50, 200, 90\] are all equal to \(x.\) What is the value of \(x?\)

solutions.text:
The sum of the seven data values is \(540+x\). If the mean equals \(x\), then \[\frac{540+x}{7}=x,\] so \(540=6x\) and \(x=90\).

With \(x=90\), the ordered data set is \(40,50,60,90,90,100,200\). Its median is \(90\), and its mode is also \(90\), so the value works.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: After finding \(x\), check that median and mode also equal \(x\)
